title: haye haye mere hussain
body:
KHAIME MEI KAISE JAAYE TERI LAASH LEKE MAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
TAKHTI HEY RAASTA TERA MASLOOM BIBIYA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
FARYAD FATEMAH KI KISSI NE NAHI SUNNI
GOWDI MEI TERE SAR KO LIYE DEKH THI RAHI
PYASEH GALE PE HOGAYA KHANJAR TERE RAWA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
MAA JAANTI HEY ISSKA SABBAB KISKI ZAAT HEY
MARNE KE BAAD BHI TERA SEENE PE HAATH HEY
AKBAR KE GUM KI DIL MEI HEY TOOTI HUWI SEENA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
KARDI HEY ZAALIMO NE ADAAWAT KI INTEHAA
TUJPAR EH LAAL HOGAYI GURBAT KI INTEHAA
DOW BHOOND TUJKO PAANI NAHI DE SAKA JAHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAINI
ITNA LAHOO BAHAA HEY KE CHERA BHI ZARD HEY
MAALOOM HEY MUJE TERE PEHLU MEI DARD HEY
TOOTI HUWI HEY MERI TARHA TERI PASLIYAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
TERA AMAAMA TERI ABAA LOOT LI GAYI
ANGOOST TERI KE WAASTE ANGOOST KAAT DI
KYA HAAL KAR DIYA TERA UMMAT NE MERI JAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
GIRTE HUWE ZAMEEN PE AWAAZ TUNE DI
MEI HOKE BEKERAAR LEHAD MEI NE REH SAKI
PHIR THOR KAR MEI BAND E KAFAN AAYI HU YEHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
PEHLE AZIYAT O SE TERA SAR JUDDA KIYA
PHIR TERI ZAKHMI LAASH KO PAMAAL KAR DIYA
QURAN JAISE JISM PE TAAPO KE HEY NISHAA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
POHCHA JO KATAL GA TAKKALUM THO YU LEGA
GOHDI MEI ABHI MAA KI LAASHA HEY GARIB KA
BINTE NABI YEH KEHTI HEY LE LE KE HICHKIYA HAI HAI MERE HUSSAIN
